latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the assigned C-R1-02 treatment critic stage. The critique covers the brief and released plan and found one minor issue: the investigator source map says IDs run S01–S10, while its records and index run S01–S12. I found no material wrong, incomplete, or unsupported claims in the bounded review; site-specific conditions remain unresolved as required. The plan’s recorded SHA-256 matched the released copy.

Independent checks confirmed the 1975 EPA document is a contractor draft, the ROHDE manual warns that a sudden full 20 L sink inflow can overflow the tank, and the Cink 2 manual excludes glazes and sewer/septic connection. [EPA report](https://nepis.epa.gov/Exe/ZyPURL.cgi?Dockey=9100XGMU.TXT) · [ROHDE manual](https://www.rohde.eu/media/pdf/c8/c0/cb/BA-TA85_202603-01_EN.pdf) · [Cink 2 manual](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2430/4931/files/Cink_2_User_Manual_-_March_2025_4a6c2381-cf81-44a9-9e63-2838b8d6ab56.pdf?v=1742533095)
